info.title: ZERODROID
info.author: Zero Data
info.description: Unofficial Boosteroid cloud-gaming client for Nintendo Switch homebrew.
info.details: ZERODROID is an open-source, unofficial Boosteroid cloud-gaming client for Nintendo Switch homebrew. It provides QR device login, a controller-first library, native H.264 video, Opus audio and full Joy-Con/Pro Controller input. v0.8.2 adds system-keyboard search, Favorites and Recently Played tabs, Spanish/English UI, server-region preferences and a live gateway ping meter. It requires a legitimate Boosteroid account and title takeover; Album/applet mode lacks enough memory. ZERODROID contains no games, CFW, DRM bypasses or Nintendo software and is not affiliated with Boosteroid or Nintendo. Application data stays under sdmc:/switch/ZERODROID/.

changelog:
v1.0.1 is the first complete official launch release of ZERODROID, tailored specifically for Nintendo Switch homebrew with native 60 FPS rendering, NVDEC hardware H.264 video decoding, Opus audio playback, and customizable streaming profiles.

✨ Key Features & Improvements in v1.0.1

High-Definition Poster Artwork:
Replaced letterboxed card artwork with vertical poster slots (v101-poster / v101-banner), featuring centered source crop and slim navy borders. Cover art is never stretched or distorted.
Complete Paginated Library & Touch Navigation:
Full tabbed browsing: My Games, Catalog, Favorites, and Recent.
Native search bar, license badges (Free, License Required, Install & Play), and persistent favorites.
Dual controller (ZL/ZR for section switching, L/R for pagination) and release-on-tap Switch touch navigation.
In-Stream Control Center (Top-Right Purple X):
Accessible in-game via the top-right purple X touch overlay.
Actions: Xbox Guide, Steam Menu (Shift + Tab), ALT+TAB, Keyboard Info, Virtual Mouse / Trackpad, UDP Reconnection, Graphic Presets, and Return to Game.
Hardware-rendered purple virtual cursor via deko3d GPU quad with 3-second auto-hide.
Resolution Modes & Image Profiles:
Resolution selector: Auto (720p handheld / 1080p docked), 720p, 1080p, and 1440p experimental.
Preset color profiles: Natural, Sharp, Vivid, Cinema, Soft, and Custom.
